citation: Abendpost (Chicago), 9 August 1905, vol. 17, no. 187: 'Bau-Erlaubnisscheine wurden ausgestellt an ...' (building permits issued), including Taprell, Loomis & Co., a four-storey brick building, 1727 to 1737 Indiana Ave.
author: Abendpost
locator: The building-permit list: 'Taprell, Loomis & Co., vierstöckiges Brick-[gebäude], 1727 bis 1737 Indiana Ave.'
rights_note: A US newspaper published in 1905, in the public domain. Read for a permit.
access_notes: Found 2026-10-24 (T-3068) through the Internet Archive's full-text search for "1737 Indiana"; German-language OCR. Eastman Kodak's 'Kodak Properties' (Rochester, 1906; item kodakproperties00east) pictures the finished building at 18th Street and Indiana Avenue, and the 1906 Directory of Directors still gives the firm's Dearborn Street address.
note: Dates the photographic-supply factory the 1911 sheet draws on 1727-1737 to after August 1905, a year after the scene.
what_it_supplies: the 1727-1737 factory was permitted in August 1905, so it did not stand on 1 July 1904
what_it_does_not_supply: what stood on the lots before it
